description:
We are looking for a Fullstack Software Engineer (x|f|m) to join our Engineering team.

As part of a collaborative and innovation-driven environment, you will contribute to building a modern cloud-based data analytics platform that helps scientists and process experts transform complex data into meaningful insights. In this Fullstack Software Engineer role, you will work across the entire software lifecycle and help deliver solutions that support our mission of Simplifying Progress. Through close collaboration with Product Management, UX and engineering teams, you will contribute to continuous improvements and create value for users worldwide.

This position is available full-time. It is a hybrid role requiring some days on site at our site in Umea with the opportunity to work some days remotely. 
 
 Grow with us – Your Responsibilities 
 Build and evolve web-based data analytics features in a modern cloud environment, continuously learning from real user feedback and usage in production

 Develop backend services using Java and Spring Boot and implement frontend components in TypeScript and React to deliver end-to-end functionality

 Ingest, transform and visualize complex data through rich, interactive charts, making information accessible and valuable for users

 Own services across their full lifecycle following a DevOps mindset (“build it, you run it”), including operating solutions in production

 Deliver value continuously through weekly production releases and frequent iterations in a fast-paced development cycle

 Collaborate closely with product management, UX and customers to understand user needs and translate them into impactful solutions

 Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture by sharing knowledge, participating in code reviews and continuously improving ways of working, including experimentation and the responsible use of modern technologies such as AI

 
 
 What will convince us 
 Academic degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a comparable scientific field

 Several years of experience as a Software Engineer working on web applications and modern software products

 Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript and React, with interest in growing towards full-stack ownership

 Experience with cloud and platform technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker and Azure DevOps as well as familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices

 Understanding of code quality, clean architecture, secure coding practices and good documentation

 Interest or experience in data visualization and the ability to make complex information accessible through thoughtful user interfaces and interactive charts

 Collaborative mindset with experience working closely with Product, UX and engineering teams, as well as appreciation for feedback, transparency and continuous learning

 Motivation to work with real users and to see solutions in production, combined with a results-oriented and proactive way of working

 Fluent English and Swedish skills

 
 
 What we offer  
 As a growing global life science company, stock listed on the German TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of benefits: 
 Personal and Professional Development: Mentoring, leadership programs, internal seminar offerings

 Work-life Balance: Remote options, flexible work schedules

 Making an impact right from the start: Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform  –  even before joining

 Welcoming Culture: Mutual support, team-spirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics such as coaching, agile working and businesswomen network

 Attractive Working Conditions : 30 days annual leave, free parking on site, free hot and cold drinks

 Health & Wellbeing : Health Insurance, wellbeing benefit of 3500 SEK a year

 Planning Ahead For Your Future : Company pension, income protection for pension

 
 We promote diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from people of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religions, age groups, disabilities, and cultural backgrounds. 
 
 
 About Sartorius  
 
 Sartorius is part of the solution in the fight against cancer, dementia, and many other diseases. Our technologies help translate scientific discoveries into real-world medicine faster, so that new therapeutics can reach patients worldwide. 
 
 We look for ambitious team players and creative minds, who want to contribute to this goal and advance their careers in a dynamic global environment.
 
 Join our global team and become part of the solution. We are looking forward to receiving your application. 
 www.sartorius.com/careers
